description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds an appointment type to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/appointmenttypes/items (JSON). Required: name; use the `fields` passthrough for description, slotLength, price, etc. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

name: create_appointment_type
title: Create an appointment type
